selected_evidence.requirement: Only root and opsadmin can schedule cron jobs (cron.allow enforcement)
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed busybox crond lacked allow/deny support, installed cronie, created opsadmin, wrote /etc/cron.allow with root and opsadmin, and proved root/opsadmin can write crontabs while a disposable testuser is rejected with 'not allowed to use this program (crontab)'.

selected_evidence.requirement: No unintended side effects: root's system periodic crontab preserved, test artifacts cleaned up
selected_evidence.summary: Restored root's original run-parts (15min/hourly/daily/weekly/monthly) crontab after test overwrite, cleared opsadmin's test entry, and confirmed the disposable testuser was fully removed.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart protocol - healthy pre-restart baseline
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (961c70eb-f0cb-488f-a55d-09dd2d6168c8), confirmed crond process running under cronie, service status started, root/opsadmin crontab state, and cron.allow content.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart protocol - restart acknowledged and node goes down
selected_evidence.summary: Issued backgrounded /sbin/reboot so the ack returned before disconnect; subsequent exec call failed with connection reset, confirming the node went down.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart protocol - changed boot identity proves restart
selected_evidence.summary: After polling through the outage, exec succeeded again with boot_id ae8d48cd-a6ee-4f63-b429-82346eab360a, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving an actual kernel restart occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart protocol - post-restart recovery of required service and config
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart, cronie crond service is running, /etc/cron.allow still lists only root and opsadmin, root's periodic crontab is intact, and a fresh test user is still denied crontab access, confirming full recovery of the cron access control state.

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== STEP baseline boot id ==="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
uptime
echo "=== STEP install cronie ==="
apk add --no-cache cronie cronie-openrc >/tmp/apk-install.log 2>&1
tail -20 /tmp/apk-install.log
echo "=== STEP verify crontab is cronie's ==="
/usr/bin/crontab -V 2>&1 || crontab -V 2>&1 || true
man crontab 2>&1 | head -0 || true
which crontab
ls -la /usr/bin/crontab
echo "=== STEP create opsadmin user if missing ==="
id opsadmin 2>&1 || adduser -D -s /bin/sh opsadmin
id opsadmin
echo "=== STEP stop/disable busybox crond if active, ensure not conflicting ==="
rc-service crond stop 2>&1 || true
rc-update del crond default 2>&1 || true
echo "=== STEP configure cron.allow ==="
printf 'root\nopsadmin\n' > /etc/cron.allow
rm -f /etc/cron.deny
cat /etc/cron.allow
ls -la /etc/cron.allow
echo "=== STEP enable cronie service ==="
rc-update add crond default 2>&1 || true
rc-service crond start 2>&1
rc-service crond status
